note: Rules fixed before any model answers them. Dev rules (dev=true) used only for prompt tuning.

rules.title_en: Dirt block stays when unsupported
rules.title_zh: 悬空土块不掉落
rules.question_en: After some time passes, what happens to the brown block floating in mid-air?
rules.question_zh: 过了一段时间后，空中悬浮的棕色方块会怎样？

options.game: It stays exactly where it is.
options.real: It slowly slides down and rests on the ground.
options.neither: It crumbles into dust and disappears.

options.game: It stays exactly as it is.
options.real: It slowly disintegrates and falls away.

rules.title_zh: 草块在无阳光的地下不会枯死

rules.title_en: Removing the base of a structure leaves the top floating
rules.title_zh: 挖掉底部方块后上方结构悬空

rules.question_zh: 把这个小塔最底部的方块挖掉之后，上面的两个方块会怎样？

options.game: They stay floating in the air.
options.real: They both collapse to the ground.
options.neither: Only the top block falls; the middle one stays.

rules.title_en: Platform stays when base is removed
rules.title_zh: 挖掉支撑后木质平台悬空不落

rules.question_zh: 把木质平台正下方的石块挖掉后，平台会怎样？

options.game: It stays exactly where it is.
options.neither: It slowly tilts and slides off.

rules.note: type 19 = Wood Platform; engine-verified stays after base removed

rules.title_en: Removing a block below another leaves it floating
rules.title_zh: 挖掉下方支撑块后上方方块悬空

options.game: It stays exactly where it is.
options.real: It immediately falls down one level.
options.neither: It slowly slides sideways.

rules.title_en: Sand falls when unsupported (action triggers it)
rules.title_zh: 挖掉支撑后沙子立即下落
rules.question_en: After the stone block directly below the sand block is removed, what happens to the sand?
rules.question_zh: 把沙块正下方的石块挖掉后，沙块会怎样？

options.game: It falls straight down.
options.neither: It spreads outward in all directions.

rules.title_en: Platforms can be walked through from below
rules.title_zh: 平台可以从下方穿过（单向通道）
rules.question_en: What happens if you place a wooden platform one block above the ground and try to walk up through it from below?
rules.question_zh: 如果在地面上方一格放置木质平台，从下方向上跳，会怎样？

options.game: You pass straight through the platform from below.
options.real: You are blocked by the platform.
options.neither: The platform breaks when you hit it from below.

rules.note: Engine-verified as placeable. Passthrough is structural game behaviour.

rules.title_en: Removing one block from a large structure leaves rest intact
rules.title_zh: 从大型结构中移除一块后其余部分不受影响
rules.question_en: After one block is removed from the middle of this row, what happens to the blocks on either side?
rules.question_zh: 把这排方块中间的一个挖掉后，两侧的方块会怎样？

options.game: They stay exactly where they are.
options.real: The blocks on each side slide toward the gap.
options.neither: They all fall into the gap.

rules.title_en: An overhanging row of blocks stays when only the edge is exposed
rules.title_zh: 悬臂结构不会因悬空端而倒塌
rules.question_en: After the rightmost supporting block is removed, leaving five blocks overhanging in mid-air, what happens?
rules.question_zh: 把最右边的支撑块移除后，五个方块悬空在空中，会怎样？

options.game: All five blocks stay where they are.
options.neither: The whole row slides to the right.

rules.title_en: Removing a block causes no chain collapse in adjacent unsupported blocks
rules.title_zh: 移除一块不会引发周围悬空块的连锁坍塌
rules.question_en: After the central support block is removed and the two side blocks are left hanging, what happens to those two side blocks?
rules.question_zh: 把中间的支撑块移除后，两侧方块就悬空了，它们会怎样？

options.game: Both side blocks stay floating.
options.neither: They start vibrating, then slowly drift apart.
